decisions.decision: Deep profit audit found the single largest economic defect yet: CHURN DRAG. Across 250 closed trades, carries held <8h (38% of all trades, 95 of 250) lose money as a class (<2h: -5.0 bps, 2-8h: -4.1 bps) while carries held longer earn (8-24h: +6.5 bps, >24h: +16.9 bps). A <2h carry captured $0.43 funding on $20,388 notional and paid a full round-trip. Realized drag -$20.14 over 20 days on $4,500 = -8.1%/yr, against a deployed Sharpe of -0.06 -- i.e. this defect is plausibly the difference between a losing and a working carry. CROSS-VALIDATION: the independently-measured cost model predicts ~3.8 bps round-trip; the realized <2h loss is 5.0 bps -- the churn loss IS execution cost paid for nothing. CAUSE is funding-sign flicker, NOT bad entries (median abs funding at open identical fast vs slow: 0.000114 vs 0.000111); COOKIEUSDT opened 22x with 16 fast closes. Logged as gap #42 TOP-RANK with a 2-part fix (minimum-hold >=8h with rails exempt; funding-sign hysteresis). NOT implemented this cycle: it changes close logic on the risk path and this session already produced two CRO-introduced risk-path bugs caught only by live verification -- it gets a test before it ships, which is discipline, not timidity.
decisions.hypothesis: most of the carry's underperformance is execution churn, not absent edge -- the funding edge is real but is being spent on round-trips
decisions.expected_benefit: removing the <8h bucket recovers ~8.1%/yr of drag; positions surviving into the 8-24h bucket earn +6.5 bps instead of losing 4-5
decisions.expected_cost: holding through adverse funding for up to 8h (~1 bp) -- an order of magnitude cheaper than the round-trip it avoids
assumptions: hold-time buckets are not confounded by regime
rails remain able to close instantly
decisions.success_metric: after the fix, <8h closes fall to rail-driven only, and net bps by bucket stops being negative
decisions.reversal_condition: if forced holds accumulate adverse funding exceeding the saved round-trip cost, raise the band or shorten the minimum hold

decisions.decision: Second and larger execution leak found + fixed (gap #43). The desk had NO minimum funding threshold -- `_ranked()` took any funding>0 -- so it opened carries on symbols sitting at Binance's BASELINE 0.0001 rate, i.e. names with no funding premium at all. Those 50 trades lost $176.24 (-92.7 bps) while every other funding bucket combined earned +$232; against a total net of +$56 that is ~80% of gross profit consumed. FIX: `_entry_gate()` requires expected funding capture over the 24h minimum hold to exceed the symbol's MEASURED round-trip cost. The floor is derived, not fitted: 4.5 bps round-trip / 3 funding periods = 1.5 bps = _MIN_FUNDING 0.00015. Per-symbol cost is read from run_cost_model.py so the gate is automatically stricter on thin books (OPUSDT 20.6 bps RT) and looser on liquid ones (BTCUSDT 0.018 bps) -- and self-tightens as the recorder accrues the traded universe. Deliberately applied to NEW OPENS ONLY, never to hold/target, so the higher bar cannot force-close existing carries (that would itself be a churn event). 6 unit tests. Together with the #42 churn guard this is the second of three compounding EXECUTION leaks -- the carry edge was largely real and was leaking out through entry quality and round-trips, not through absent alpha.

decisions.decision: Gap #34 ($1.8-2.6k unexplained, flagged UNRESOLVED by a near-unanimous 13-model panel) is now ATTRIBUTED at fill level. This is the SAME pathology as #42/#43 -- GTC and ONE are the exact names the churn audit flagged -- so the shipped churn guard, entry gate and orphan cooldown attack its root. The CRO original modest-slippage framing was wrong and the panel was right to reject it.

decisions.decision: Built gap #25 (always-valid sequential testing) and then REFUTED MY OWN PROPOSAL with its own Monte Carlo. I had recommended anytime-valid inference to the principal as the principled way to get FASTER forward validation instead of cutting 90->40 days. Measured: type-I control is verified (null crossing 3/300 = 1.0% at alpha=0.01, exactly the bound), but a genuine Sharpe~2 edge graduates in a MEDIAN 132 days versus the fixed 90-day clock, and only 6/40 paths graduate at all. The cause is fundamental: daily returns at Sharpe 2 carry per-observation signal ~0.105, so the e-process grows ~0.0055/day and needs ~800 days to reach log(1/alpha). So the honest conclusion is that there is NO free lunch on validation speed -- a shorter clock lowers the bar, an always-valid test raises it, and no test can be simultaneously faster and stricter on the same data. The only real accelerants are more observations (higher frequency, cross-sectional breadth). ADOPTED as a stricter optional secondary check; the 40/90-day clock STANDS and the principal's 90->40 request stays declined -- now on measured rather than theoretical grounds.

decisions.expected_benefit: REFUTED -- it is slower for Sharpe-2-class edges on daily data; the value delivered is a verified-rigorous secondary check plus the knowledge that no test buys speed without lowering the bar
decisions.expected_cost: one build; the CRO's own recommendation withdrawn on evidence
assumptions: daily-frequency returns
alpha=0.01
Sharpe~2 as the strong-edge case
decisions.success_metric: used as a secondary gate on high-stakes promotions; never cited as a speedup

decisions.decision: TWO SHIPPED + THREE ASSESSED-AND-DEFERRED (principal: implement the max-ROI list, and make the validation bar a fixed wall unaffected by how many hypotheses are tested). SHIPPED 1 -- FIXED-WALL DEFLATION (libs/autodiscovery/orchestrator.py): the DSR trial count was n_new + store.total(), a GLOBAL cumulative pool, so every hypothesis ever tested harshened every future bar -- objective #2 (maximize discovery) mechanically sabotaged objective #1. Now deflation is (a) PARTITIONED per family (standard per-family error budgeting; families are pre-registered and economically distinct, so testing cross-asset can no longer harshen the funding-mechanism bar) and (b) computed from a PRE-REGISTERED family budget (default 120), a CONSTANT -- so re-running a space does not move the bar (content-hash dedup already means a re-run is not new information; charging deflation for it was double-counting). Sharpe estimates are family-scoped too so the DSR stays internally consistent. The correction is NOT removed: max() lets the bar rise if a family genuinely EXCEEDS its declared budget, because that is real extra searching. REFUSED the literal ask (a bar wholly independent of trials) -- that is the phantom-edge machine and contradicts the desk's own honesty guard; the principal's real concern (a ratchet punishing throughput) is fully solved by the legitimate version. VERIFIED: 120/120/120 fixed across families at or under budget, 290 only on a 200-new overflow, unrelated families unaffected. SHIPPED 2 -- CLOCK-SATURATION CHECK (scripts/max_audit.py): objective #2's flagship duty ('every verified axis must have a hypothesis accruing within 7d') existed as PROMPT TEXT ONLY and so was skipped silently. Now fenced, reading axes from the Bronze lake (what was actually ingested) and clocks from cadence_state gen_done_* (what actually ran). FIRST RUN CAUGHT A MAJOR BREACH: 13/13 verified axes have NO hypothesis accruing -- binance_metrics, cme, crossasset, crypto, energy, equity, etf_flows, fed and more, ALL 'never'. Every ingested axis (including the paid CME pull) is idle research capital; this was invisible while the duty was prose. Independently confirms the 2026-07-22 diagnosis that the constraint is DATA/MECHANISM: the data is ingested but never converted into tested hypotheses. ASSESSED AND CORRECTLY DEFERRED (evidence, not fatigue): (i) COMPOUNDING RE-ANCHOR -- the single biggest CAGR lever, but realised PnL is NEGATIVE (-63.60/7d), the equity_curve feed is ~1 month stale (last row 2026-06-28) and gap #14 keeps the optimizer quarantined, so there is literally nothing to compound and wiring it now would compound a stale/negative signal -- the incident-#2 contaminated-statistic failure. Promoted to a BLOCKING Gate-0 checklist item with the safe design (realised PnL only, never raw equity which testnet faucet bags inflate to ~10.8k). (ii) PARALLEL 8h CHALLENGERS -- premature: one sleeve exists and zero are validated, so there is nothing to parallelise; the fixed wall now makes it SAFE for when 2+ orthogonal sleeves exist. (iii) BNB FEE DISCOUNT -- maker-first is already implemented (_MAKER=True, post-only with taker fallback); the BNB half needs a funded live account, so it stays a Gate-0 principal action. (iv) FUNDING-CONDITIONAL CHURN -- dropped by the principal and correctly so: 24h is documented as the profit-maximising floor (holding to 24h risks <=3bps to save 4.5; beyond ~32h adverse funding wins) and _FUNDING_PANIC already provides the conditional escape.

The NAV attestation shows realized_spot_pnl=635.55, and run_derivative_shadow already carries TWO sleeves. The stale equity_curve feed I cited (last row 2026-06-28) is a real but SEPARATE defect: it is the retired crypto sleeve's table, not the carry book's accounting, so it was the wrong source to judge by. decisions.decision: Principal ordered that hypothesis generation must NEVER move the DSR/validation bar -- objectives 1 and 2 must not conflict. RESOLVED PERMANENTLY with the textbook architecture, codified as the TWO-STAGE DISCOVERY LAW: Stage A (backtest gauntlet incl. fixed-wall) = SCREEN with zero promotion authority -- generation unbounded, multiplicity there affects ordering only, phantom edges impossible because nothing promotes from it; Stage B (pre-registered forward clocks) = SOLE promotion authority, where generation volume is statistically invisible (new data cannot be overfit by pre-window siblings) and the only real multiplicity -- concurrent slot count -- is Holm-corrected and hard-capped at MAX_FORWARD_SLOTS=12. The confirmation bar is thus a constant for life. Slot admission by EV-rank; anti-gaming (graveyard, content-hash, kill-basis, pre-registration) unchanged. Mechanical enforcement: slot_budget_exceeded alert (over-enrollment) pairs with the clock-saturation check (under-use) -> always-full-never-over. Side effect: the fixed-wall deflation dispute becomes low-stakes (screen ordering only); panel review stands but the promotion pathway no longer depends on its outcome.
decisions.hypothesis: screening/confirmation separation gives unlimited generation with a life-constant confirmation bar and bounded false-promotion rate
decisions.expected_benefit: objectives 1+2 permanently deconflicted; max generation throughput with zero added phantom risk; bar can never ratchet OR be pressured down
decisions.expected_cost: screen survivors may queue for slots (good problem; EV-rank + recycling)
assumptions: forward pre-registration discipline holds
slot cap enforced by alert + audit
decisions.success_metric: confirmation bar unchanged across arbitrary generation volume; false-promotion rate tracks per-slot alpha x slots only
decisions.reversal_condition: if slot queueing ever materially delays a high-EV candidate, raise MAX_FORWARD_SLOTS explicitly WITH its recomputed Holm bar -- a ledgered constant change, never a silent drift

decisions.decision: SCREEN-ON-DISCOVERY DUTY approved by the principal and wired as standing law. HIS PROPOSAL: every digger and miner should test hypotheses IMMEDIATELY on discovering a dataset, checking for survivors the same way. CRO VERDICT: APPROVED -- the evidence is this session itself (420 price-family hypotheses -> 0 survivors, versus ONE new axis, kimchi premium, screened in ~1h -> IC +0.148, momentum Sharpe 1.3, beating every price-only sleeve ever rejected). It closes the desk's oldest structural leak: catalog breadth ~8.5/10 vs ingested-and-tested ~4.5/10 -- diggers were librarians, not researchers. THE GAP FOUND ON AUDIT: TWO_STAGE_DISCOVERY_LAW.md and the harness libs/research/axis_screen.py BOTH already existed, but the duty was wired into 0 of 7 organs -- the law and the tool were built and nothing instructed any digger to use them, so the discovery->test loop stayed open. NOW WIRED into ops/principal_doctrine.txt (reaches cycle + 4 diggers + 7 regional miners via --append-system-prompt) and DIGGING_CHARTER section 26 (binds all diggers present and future); a dig that surfaces an axis without reporting its Stage-A verdict in the same run is an INCOMPLETE dig. APPROVED WITH SIX NON-NEGOTIABLE GUARDS, because naked mass-screening is a phantom-edge factory: (1) must use the audited harness (de-contamination/angle-20 artifact gate is baked in and unskippable -- it is what graveyarded Coinbase-premium AND Turkey-premium as pure timing artifacts); (2) mechanism prior required before screening, since screening everything catalogued is breadth-mining with extra steps (already refuted by 420/0); (3) EVERY construction tried is logged as a trial, not just the one that printed -- this comes directly from the CRO's own near-miss this session (USDT-denominated build came back ~0, FX-denominated printed 1.3; the switch was mechanism-driven and defensible but is STRUCTURALLY IDENTICAL to garden-of-forking-paths p-hacking); (4) timestamp alignment must be declared and look-ahead risk flagged (a daily FX close is NOT the crypto UTC close) or the screen is void; (5) ZERO promotion authority -- Stage A earns a pre-registered forward clock, never capital; (6) negative screens are first-class deliverables, graveyarded with reason, silent drops forbidden. STATISTICAL SAFETY: this is sound precisely BECAUSE the two-stage law already separates screening from confirmation -- Stage A has no promotion authority so its multiplicity cannot create a phantom edge at ANY volume, and Stage B confirms on forward data which is immune to generation volume by construction. Unlimited screening is therefore genuinely free. NEIGHBOURS: TWO_STAGE_DISCOVERY_LAW, axis_screen harness, objective #2 clock-saturation duty, check_clock_saturation in max_audit.

decisions.decision: FORWARD CLOCKS WERE NOT TICKING -- root cause found and fixed. The principal asked how to make screen->shadow->live faster; the honest answer was that the pipeline was not slow, it was UNSCHEDULED. scripts/daily_research_cycle.py advances EVERY forward clock (kimchi gap-74), the cost model, shadow_8h, nav_attest, listing_watch, stablecoin/FRED collectors, the crypto factory and git_snapshot -- 22 steps -- and its ONLY invoker was scripts/watchdog.py, which is DEAD (no process, systemd quant-watchdog inactive, not in crontab). data/.last_cro_cycle sat 11.5 days stale (07-11) while cro_cycle_log showed 07-19..07-22 entries: those runs came from INTERACTIVE SESSIONS, not automation. So Stage-B forward evidence accrued only when a human happened to have a session open -- the kimchi clock had exactly 1 row (its creation day) and would never have reached the 40-day bar. FIX: a direct pgrep-guarded cron (02:00Z daily, detached, logged) for daily_research_cycle.py -- deterministic, with NO dependency on the dead watchdog. VERIFIED by triggering a run: all 22 steps green, kimchi clock advanced 1->2 rows, cro_cycle_log gained its 2026-07-23 entry. NOTABLE from that run: shadow_8h reached NW-t 1.87 (above the 1.65 bar) at 82 blocks (~27d) with vif 1.20 -- the 8h-block challenger delivering the ~1.7x validation compression in production, where the daily path would still be accruing. This is a ZERO-STATISTICAL-COST speedup: no window was shortened, no bar lowered; clocks simply now advance autonomously instead of on human presence. RESIDUAL FLAGGED: (a) the watchdog remains dead -- its respawn duties for recorders/deadman are already covered by their own crons and systemd, but if it is ever revived it will immediately spawn a DUPLICATE cycle because .last_cro_cycle is stale (it is only written by the watchdog, not by this cron); (b) NOTHING still reads the accruing clock files to compute Stage-B stats (nw_tstat/holm_bar exist in libs/validation/forward_stats.py but no caller) -- so eligibility will not be detected automatically even once the evidence lands. That is the next latency to remove.
decisions.hypothesis: forward validation latency was operational (unscheduled clocks), not statistical; restoring a deterministic scheduler makes evidence accrue on calendar time instead of human presence
decisions.expected_benefit: forward clocks advance every day autonomously; Stage-B eligibility becomes reachable at all, at zero statistical cost
decisions.expected_cost: one heavy detached cycle per day (~20-40min, isolated steps, idempotent)
decisions.assumptions: the cron survives; steps stay isolated so one failure never aborts the cycle
decisions.success_metric: kimchi and future axis clocks gain one row per calendar day without any human session; cro_cycle_log gains a dated entry daily
decisions.reversal_condition: if the daily cycle ever collides with a revived watchdog spawn, gate one of them on a shared marker -- do not remove the cron

decisions.decision: GAP #19 (venue-truth divergence breaker) PUT ON SHADOW, and the shadow immediately proved the spec unarmable as written. CONTEXT: gap #19 is the one accepted kimi-attributed tier1 finding (moonshotai 'Venue-Truth-First Risk Measurement', corroborated unprompted by google/gemini 'Venue-Truth Disconnect Circuit Breaker' -- kimi's other two tier1 findings were rejected). It was spec'd (GAP19_RECONCILE_GUARD_SPEC.md) and queued post-Gate-0 but never observed. APPROVED SHADOW-FIRST because the spec calibrates its band at '~2x OBSERVED noise' and the noise had never been measured -- arming a threshold against unmeasured noise is EXACTLY what produced the 2026-07-22 dead-man false fires. Shipped scripts/run_venue_divergence_shadow.py: strictly read-only, never pauses/pages/flattens, and NEVER writes the dead-man state (two-writers-on-one-rail was the 07-11 false-fire root cause). Cron */5. FINDING (immediate, decisive): the two NAV feeds are BOTH FRESH and identically timestamped, yet sit ~36.4% apart BY CONSTRUCTION -- live_combined marks a 15,000-based book while the dead-man measure is fut margin + TRACKED legs + USDT delta, deliberately excluding untracked faucet spot ('immune to mark-based accounting blindness'). So the spec's LEVEL comparison would have tripped INSTANTLY AND PERMANENTLY on a definitional offset, not a reconciliation break -- it was broken-on-arrival and would have looked like a real venue divergence. CORRECTED SIGNAL: divergence of INCREMENTS, |d(mark)-d(venue)| per tick, which measures the two measures DRIFTING APART (the real break) while ignoring a harmless constant offset. Measured 0.0071% early -> armable band ~0.014% (2x observed increment noise). The sampler now reports level offset as DEFINITIONAL-do-not-band and increments as the calibration signal. STILL QUEUED: arming needs >=200 clean samples spanning rebalances and >=1 regime event, plus the property/mutation bar and the independence gate (I had already touched the rail and executor today). LESSON GENERALISED: a risk trigger whose band is defined relative to 'observed noise' must be shadow-measured before it is armed; and two feeds must be proven to share a BASIS before they are differenced.
decisions.hypothesis: shadow-measuring a proposed risk trigger before arming it surfaces basis mismatches and gives a real calibration, at zero risk
decisions.expected_benefit: prevented arming a breaker that would have tripped permanently on a definitional offset; produced a genuine band (~0.014%) and the correct signal (increments)
decisions.expected_cost: one read-only sampler on a 5-min cron; arming still waits on sample count
assumptions: increment divergence is the right reconciliation signal once a constant basis offset is accepted
both feeds keep updating on the same 3-min tick
decisions.success_metric: >=200 clean samples accumulate; increment p95 stays small and stable, giving a defensible band before Gate 0
decisions.reversal_condition: if increment divergence proves unstable/regime-dependent, the breaker needs a basis-reconciled NAV pair instead of a band -- do NOT widen the band to silence it

decisions.decision: DAILY INTEGRITY WATCH run on ground truth. Carry-leak alarm reads alert=False ('clean: non-funding PnL +563.07 not a drain'), but reporting that at face value would be exactly the rubber-stamping the doctrine forbids. THREE HONEST QUALIFICATIONS: (1) THE CHECK DOES NOT YET MEET ITS OWN STANDARD -- the spot input used was realized_spot_pnl from data/cashcarry_positions.json, which is an ACCUMULATOR, while the integrity doctrine explicitly requires the exchange-ground-truth derive_spot_realized. Until the alarm is fed ground truth its verdict is provisional. (2) non_funding_pnl = +563.07 on a DELTA-NEUTRAL book, where the honest target is ~0 because the legs cancel. The alarm only fires on DRAINS, so a large POSITIVE non-funding figure passes silently -- an asymmetry worth closing, since an unexplained +563 is as much a measurement question as an unexplained -563. (3) THE STRATEGY IS BARELY EARNING: venue income over 7d is FUNDING_FEE +16.27, REALIZED_PNL -9.11, COMMISSION -47.10 (1000 records). The funding harvest -- the actual edge being deployed -- is 16.27 USD over 7 days on a 4,500 book, roughly 0.36%/yr gross, and commissions (-47.10) are nearly 3x the entire harvest. That is the single most important number found this cycle: the deployed sleeve is paying more in fees than it collects in funding. It reframes the BNB fee-discount lever from 'nice riskless trim' to decisive, and it means the churn/entry-gate fixes are load-bearing rather than incremental. decisions.decision: RECONSTRUCTED HELD-OUT OOS VALIDATOR built + first axis KILLED (MAX_SURVIVORS_PROGRAM Part 1 #1, the highest-ROI lever both accounts independently ranked #1). KEY INTEGRITY FINDING that shaped the build: the naive backfill (stuff reconstructed history into run_axis_shadows forward clock) is FORBIDDEN by the desk own design -- the clock code comment states its entire statistical basis is that rows are dated AFTER pre-registration so they cannot be overfit; the collector screen already saw ~2y of history, so backfilling the clock would manufacture phantom validation. The valid form (scripts/backfill_onchain_oos.py): lock params from the recent screen window, backtest on the EARLIER history the screen never saw = genuine held-out OOS available TODAY instead of in 40 forward days; kept ARCHITECTURALLY SEPARATE from the forward clock with zero promotion authority (a real edge must survive both). Mandatory anti-phantom gate: diff-verify reconstruction vs forward ground truth, abort on misalignment (bithumb/timezone class). RESULT: on-chain throughput reversal OOS-FAILS on 11y held-out (2013-2024, 4061 days) -- IC +0.0025, ann Sharpe -0.03, deflated fails, regime thirds [-0.3,-0.08,+0.37] = worked ONLY recently (overfit signature the collector itself suspected). The lever worked exactly as intended: a 40-day wait became a same-day KILL. DIFF-VERIFY BONUS BUG: the collector date-stamps blockchain.info latest point with today, but that point lags 1 day -> the forward on-chain clock signal is 1 day STALE (staleness, not lookahead -- safe direction). Brain should align label to data date. CTO NOTE on the QRIS 12-division prompt: approved as a ROADMAP, built by ROI order not as a cathedral -- the disciplined core is already MAX_SURVIVORS_PROGRAM.md (survivors are the KPI, NO swarm/volume). This build IS that discipline: it makes candidates die FAST rather than manufacturing more of them.

decisions.decision: HONEST META-FINDING on the reconstructed-history backfill (MAX_SURVIVORS_PROGRAM Part 1 #1, ranked #1 by two accounts): it is a REAL lever but AXIS-LIMITED, not the universal quick win the program framing implied. Per-axis reality, verified tonight: (1) ON-CHAIN throughput -- deep free single-asset history (blockchain.info, 11y) -> held-out OOS RAN and KILLED the axis (IC ~0, only-recent-era Sharpe = overfit). decisions.decision: UNKNOWN IS NOT ZERO on the carry measurement path. FOUND BY THE DAILY INTEGRITY WATCH: the primary executed book published funding_harvested=0.00 and a bleed_verdict of 'inf% -- hedge losing more than it earns'. GROUND TRUTH CONTRADICTED IT: web/portfolio.json (molded book, 17:58Z) recorded funding=101.96 on the same book/venue. ROOT CAUSE: /fapi/v1/income returned HTTP 502 persistently (verified 3/3 live attempts this cycle); in _mark() the equity read and the income read shared ONE `_safe()` block, so the equity assignment landed and the income call then threw -- the swallowed exception left funding/commission at their initialised 0.0. A PARTIAL update: real futures PnL published next to a fabricated zero harvest, which is exactly the combination the alarm reads as a total bleed. An HTTP 502 was rendered as an economic verdict. THIS IS THE SAME FAILURE SHAPE AS THE 2026-07-19 STRANDED-INVENTORY INCIDENT (GAP row 34), where `_safe()` made a rejected order indistinguishable from a filled one; that was fixed on the ORDER path (`_filled`) and left standing on the MEASUREMENT path -- the adjacency move (proactive battery #2) is what found it. FIX: (1) new carry_accounting.read_income returns None -- never a zero-filled dict -- and retries transient 5xx (reads are idempotent; orders deliberately are NOT retried this way); (2) _mark gives the income read its OWN guard and initialises funding/commission to None; (3) carry_bleed_report accepts funding=None and returns measured=False with an UNMEASURED verdict instead of dividing by a fabricated zero -- and __bool__ now requires measured, so an unmeasured book cannot read as healthy; (4) leak_attribution is SKIPPED when the fee bill is unknown, because with commission=0 the whole fee bill lands in `residual` and manufactures precisely the phantom that function's own docstring warns against; (5) ADJACENCY: run_live_combined had the same shape half-fixed -- venue_realized already used the None-means-unknown pattern while funding two lines above still seeded 0.0, and its `except (ValueError, TypeError)` could not even catch the venue's HTTPError, so that book crashed outright (portfolio.json went 2h stale) -- now uses read_income too, plus a self-healing levered-lab baseline so a fund0 seeded during an outage is adopted on first real read rather than anchored to a fake zero. (6) The fix makes the alarm go QUIET during an outage, which is only safe if the silence is itself tracked: new max_audit check_carry_funding_measured fires whenever funding_measured is not True.
decisions.hypothesis: A measurement that fails must be reported as unmeasured, never as zero. Zero and unknown are different states and conflating them corrupts both the alarm (false inf% bleed) and the forward track record the sizing gate reads (carry edge silently erased).
decisions.expected_benefit: Removes a live corruption of the desk's PRIMARY evidence stream. Kills a false-alarm class that trains the desk to ignore the carry-leak alarm -- the alarm's whole value is that it is believed. Restores honest funding accrual to the forward record the growth ladder sizes on. No E[log wealth] estimate is claimed: this is measurement integrity, whose value is that every downstream number stops being wrong, not a direct return.
decisions.expected_cost: ~90 lines across 4 files + 5 regression tests. Maintenance near zero (removes a special case rather than adding one). Risk: downstream consumers must tolerate null -- see NEIGHBOURS.

decisions.decision: DUAL SUPERVISION WAS ORPHANING THE PRIMARY BOOK, AND THE ORPHAN WAS RUNNING PRE-FIX CODE. Found by STEP-0 integrity watch. Chain, each link verified by fresh read: (1) scripts/watchdog.py:149 Popen-spawns the cash-carry executor directly every 3min from cron, with start_new_session -- laptop-era code never updated when the desk moved to systemd on 07-12, so anything it starts is owned by cron, NOT by quant-cashcarry.service. (2) That orphan (pid 817906, up since 12:48:01Z) held the single-instance heartbeat lock, so every systemd spawn printed 'already running' and exited 0; with Restart=always/RestartSec=15 the unit respawned against it ~190x/hour -- NRestarts=5354 observed. (3) The orphan had loaded its modules at 12:48, while the funding-measurement fix (ledger 2026-07-26-carry-funding-silent-zero) was written to disk at 20:06/20:07. So that fix was INERT in the only process that owned the book: web/cashcarry_live.json at 20:44 still published funding_harvested=0.00 and 'BLEED: inf% -- hedge losing more than it earns', an HTTP 502 rendered as an economic verdict, into the forward track record the sizing gate reads. A committed fix is not a shipped fix. BOTH failure classes were ALREADY WRITTEN DOWN and neither was gated: institutional_knowledge.md:141 ('a committed fix is INERT until the process is restarted', 2026-07-10) and :290 (exit-under-Restart=always storm, 14,225 restarts, 2026-07-13). The 07-13 storm fix was applied to the KILL exit and left standing on the SINGLETON exit 380 lines away in the same file -- the adjacency move found it. FIXES: (a) executor singleton path now STANDS BY (sleep+recheck on the same PID-aware predicate the in-loop check uses) instead of exiting, mirroring the kill-path precedent -- storm ends and the book is taken over automatically when the owner dies; (b) watchdog._spawn defers to systemd when the unit has a live MainPID, closing the orphan factory, and KEEPS the Popen backstop when systemd has nothing running (an orphan is recoverable, a dead ruin rail is not, and this box denies systemctl to the quant user); (c) max_audit check_stale_daemons discovered workers via systemd MainPID and skipped on '0' -- which is exactly what systemd reports during the auto-restart state an orphan causes, so the inert-code detector was blind to the commonest way code goes inert; it now discovers workers independently of systemd and reports an ownership mismatch as its own defect. VERIFIED LIVE END-TO-END: orphan killed 20:55, standby took the book 20:58:22, heartbeat PID == systemd MainPID == 877230 (sole worker, argv-exact), NRestarts frozen at 5354, and the book's first honest mark landed 20:58:37 -- bleed_alert True->False, funding_measured=False, verdict now 'UNMEASURED: funding harvest unavailable' instead of the fabricated inf% BLEED. Underlying cause of the unmeasured term is venue-side and confirmed independently this cycle: binance testnet /fapi/v1/income returns HTTP 502 on 3/3 attempts while positions() succeeds -- an endpoint-specific outage, not our auth. The book's 3 short perp legs match its 3 carries; no stranded legs.
decisions.hypothesis: A singleton daemon supervised by two independent supervisors will orphan under any race, and an orphan silently pins the process to the code it loaded at spawn time. Removing the second supervisor and making the lock stand by rather than exit eliminates both the storm and the inert-code channel without weakening the single-book invariant.
decisions.expected_benefit: Restores the primary book to supervised, current code -- the fix that makes the carry-leak alarm honest is now actually running. Ends ~190 wasted process spawns/hour. Converts two documented-but-ungated lessons (IK:141, IK:290) into a standing mechanical check, so the next inert fix is caught by the sweep instead of by hand. Protects the forward track record the sizing gate reads from fabricated edge terms.
decisions.expected_cost: ~90 lines across 3 files plus one behavioural change to startup logic on a money-path file. Residual: a systemd-owned process may now sit in standby indefinitely if an orphan is created by some path not yet known -- visible via the new ownership defect.
decisions.assumptions: (1) systemd MainPID + /proc is authoritative for ownership on this box; (2) the deadman rail keeps its Popen backstop whenever systemd has no live process, so its availability is never reduced -- only its double-spawn risk is; (3) the venue 502 is transient and endpoint-specific.
decisions.success_metric: Sustained: quant-cashcarry NRestarts stops climbing; heartbeat PID equals systemd MainPID on every subsequent sweep; daemon-stale-code / daemon-unsupervised stay clear; and carry-funding-unmeasured clears on its own when the venue endpoint recovers (funding_measured flips True) WITHOUT any code change -- if it does not, the cause was ours.
decisions.reversal_condition: If the standby path ever leaves the book unattended (heartbeat stale >5min with a live systemd process standing by), or if deferring to systemd leaves any daemon down that the watchdog would have restarted, revert to checkpoint 20260726T204946_carry-singleton-storm-fix and restore the direct Popen path.
decisions.named_neighbours: quant-cashcarry.service restart semantics; scripts/watchdog.py supervision regime for ALL FOUR daemons it spawns (dashboard, cashcarry, liquidations, and the TIER-3 dead-man rail -- the deadman's Popen backstop is deliberately preserved for the systemd-has-nothing case and its own file is untouched); the carry-leak alarm and carry_bleed_report; the forward track record and the shrunk-Kelly sizing gate that reads its funding term; max_audit's daemon and carry-funding checks; cron's 3-minute watchdog tick.

decisions.decision: Principal proposed a 26-layer 'Elite Trader Intelligence Alpha Factory' (trader discovery -> identity resolution -> skill attribution -> behavioural embeddings -> decay forecasting -> counter-trader -> capital scaling). REFUSED to build the edifice; tested the PREMISE it all rests on instead (layers 2-26 are conditional on trader behaviour carrying extractable predictive information). ANGLE-14 FIRST: the desk ALREADY collects globalLongShortAccountRatio (retail crowd, 314 syms/day) and already DSR-KILLED ls_contrarian on it (bt Sharpe 9.84 -> overfit); Binance's individual-trader leaderboard API is DEAD (404), so per-trader identity resolution is not free-sourceable there. The genuine uncovered gap was the ELITE cohort: topLongShortPositionRatio / topLongShortAccountRatio. Screened 4 signals x 5 majors at 4h (180 bars) through the hardened harness. RESULT: premise FAILS. smart_dumb_divergence (elite MINUS retail = the direct 'do skilled traders lead the crowd' test) pooled IC +0.0032 (t +0.15) -- ZERO. elite_acct t -0.32, retail_baseline t -0.51 (consistent with the ls_contrarian kill). 0 of 20 per-symbol screens passed. ONLY sign-consistent result: elite_pos (size-weighted elite conviction) pooled mean IC -0.0377, t -3.66, NEGATIVE in all 5 symbols = fade-the-elite contrarian. NOT WIRED: 5 correlated majors are not 5 independent tests (effective N ~1-2), mean reversal Sharpe only 0.77, and it is a close cousin of the already-DSR-killed ls_contrarian. Logged as a pre-registered candidate needing an independent-universe test, not an axis.
decisions.hypothesis: skilled/elite crypto traders' aggregate positioning carries forward predictive information beyond the retail crowd (the premise of the whole 26-layer spec)
decisions.expected_benefit: would have justified the full trader-intelligence build if the premise held
decisions.expected_cost: one screen session; avoided building 26 subsystems on an unvalidated premise
assumptions: Binance top-trader cohort is a fair proxy for 'skilled'
4h aggregate granularity is where such an edge would show
decisions.success_metric: n/a -- premise rejected at Stage-A
decisions.reversal_condition: per-TRADER (not aggregate) data on a transparent venue shows skill persistence -- Hyperliquid clearinghouseState is free + per-address (probe: OK) and is the ONLY remaining free route to the individual-skill question. That is a separate, harder test requiring address discovery + survivorship-free cohort construction.
decisions.flagged_gap: elite_pos contrarian (t -3.66 pooled, sign-consistent 5/5) is the one live thread: needs a wider INDEPENDENT universe (not 5 correlated majors) before it can be considered an axis. Do not wire on correlated-symbol evidence.

decisions.decision: Principal (confident because 'top profitable traders get copytraded') asked for the per-trader test after the aggregate elite-positioning premise failed. Built it on Hyperliquid -- the one free venue with genuine per-trader transparency (public leaderboard 40,988 addresses INCLUDING large losers, e.g. -$3.3M month PnL; plus per-address clearinghouseState + 2,000 userFills). Cohort 8,026 after acctValue>=$10k and monthVlm>=$100k filters. Used the leaderboard's nested windows to build NON-OVERLAPPING formation/holding splits, winsorised tails, shuffled-label null, and within-size-bucket controls. ROUND 1 (adjacent windows): rho +0.120, t +10.86, 5x the shuffled null, decile spread +6.1%/wk (t 4.12), and it SURVIVED all three size buckets -> looked like genuine skill persistence, the session's first positive result. ROUND 2 (the confound control that mattered): inserted a ~3-week GAP so no single position can span both windows -> rho INVERTS to -0.064 (t -5.8); long-horizon variant -0.060 (t -5.4); gapped decile spreads insignificant (t 1.33/1.15). CONCLUSION: the apparent persistence was POSITION-OVERLAP MECHANICS plus directional beta in a mildly trending market, not skill. Robust in the safe direction -- the snapshot omits fully-liquidated accounts, which biases persistence UP, so true persistence <= -0.064. Top-decile forward returns were NEGATIVE in all variants. Also self-caught a BUG in my own verdict logic: it printed SURVIVES for negative rho because it tested |t| and |rho| without checking SIGN -- numbers right, labels wrong; reported rather than hidden. NOTHING WIRED. The 26-layer spec is refused at its premise.
decisions.hypothesis: individual crypto traders exhibit skill persistence -- past risk-adjusted performance predicts future performance -- which is the necessary precondition for any copytrading or trader-intelligence alpha
decisions.expected_benefit: would have justified the full trader-intelligence build; instead saved 26 subsystems of engineering on a premise that inverts under a gap control
decisions.expected_cost: two screen rounds; reusable gapped-persistence harness retained
assumptions: HL leaderboard window PnL/accountValue are accurate as published
3-week gap is sufficient to break position-carry correlation
decisions.success_metric: n/a -- hypothesis refuted at Stage-A with a confound control
decisions.reversal_condition: a GAPPED design on data that includes fully-liquidated accounts (true survivorship-free panel, e.g. reconstructed from fills history rather than a current snapshot) shows positive persistence. Any future copytrading/trader-intelligence proposal MUST use a gapped formation/holding split or it is measuring position carry, not skill.
decisions.flagged_gap: GENERAL LESSON for the desk: adjacent-window performance-persistence tests are structurally contaminated by open-position carry. The gapped-window control belongs in the standard screen toolkit alongside the de-contamination and lookahead rails.

decisions.decision: Principal asked to search AGGRESSIVELY for any way to make trader-intelligence alpha work after two failures. Held the anti-p-hacking line: instead of re-slicing one hypothesis until something crossed 0.05, PRE-REGISTERED 3 DISTINCT ECONOMIC MECHANISMS with a multiplicity-adjusted bar (|t|>=2.7) and tested them. (1) AGGREGATE elite positioning (Binance top-trader ratios): pooled t +0.15 = zero. (2) SKILL PERSISTENCE (HL, 8,026 traders): adjacent-window rho +0.120 (t +10.9) INVERTED to -0.064 under a 3-week gap control -> the 'persistence' was open-position carry + directional beta in a trending market. (3) ELITE DIRECTIONAL ORDER FLOW (does elite flow LEAD price -- the actual copytrading mechanism, spec layer 10): designed around both circularity traps (performance-blind cohort selection; flow(t) vs ret(t+1) only). Mid-experiment self-caught design flaw: top-VOLUME selection picks HFT/market-makers (2000 fills in 30 minutes) whose flow is INVENTORY not conviction -- the spec's own layer-11 rule -- so re-selected on turnover ratio (1-25x/mo). First pass looked alive (BTC IC +0.157, pooled t +3.00) but n=2 coins is not a sample and both coins read UNDERPOWERED. The breadth/stability re-run KILLED IT: adding 60 traders to the SAME selection rule flipped BTC IC +0.157 -> -0.033 and tripped TIMING-ARTIFACT (same-period +0.202); ETH's IC (+0.110) and tercile spread (-0.524%) had OPPOSITE signs. Root cause is mechanical: taker flow is CONCURRENT with price (buying moves price), so it cannot lead it. STRUCTURAL WALL found: userFills caps at 2000 fills/address, so 14/16 coins were untestable -- historical breadth is unobtainable from the free snapshot API; only forward accumulation could build it. decisions.decision: Principal objected -- correctly -- that the trader-skill tests were unfair: ONE-WEEK holding window (noise vs a long-horizon trader's signal), no track-record filter, and ranking on RAW PnL (rewards one lucky levered bet). Conceded all three and built the strongest version: 229 Hyperliquid traders with LONG verified on-chain records (median 621d, max 1195d = 3.3yr), each split on their OWN equity curve (formation = first 60%, holding = last 40% -> long horizons both sides, natural gap, no lookahead), using pnlHistory normalised by contemporaneous accountValue so deposits/withdrawals are not mistaken for returns, returns clipped to kill single-step artifacts. Ranked by RISK-ADJUSTED criteria, not PnL. RESULT: formation Sharpe -> holding return rho -0.019 (t -0.28) = ZERO predictive power. Consistency t +0.45, total return t +0.73 -- all zero. Cohort holding mean -3.3%, median -11.9%, only 92/229 positive. PARTIAL EXCEPTION: formation DRAWDOWN CONTROL -> holding return rho +0.135 (t +2.05), top-quartile +2.3% vs bottom -18.0% -- does NOT clear the 4-test multiplicity bar (~2.5), so logged not wired, but economically consistent with the classic result that RISK characteristics persist while RETURNS do not. Also answered the 'dig deeper into Chinese/niche verified traders' push: HL on-chain data is the STRONGEST evidence class available (cryptographically verifiable, includes losers, no self-reporting); curated/self-reported track records from any region are strictly WEAKER evidence, and enlarging the candidate pool AMPLIFIES the winner's curse rather than solving it. The failure is not 'could not find skilled traders' -- 229 multi-year profitable traders were found -- it is that WITHIN that population past performance does not predict future performance.

decisions.decision: Principal challenged the STATISTICAL POWER of the long-term skill test ('are u even testing it for long enough to judge'). CORRECT CHALLENGE, conceded with the math: n=229 gave SE(rho)~0.066 -> could only detect |rho|>=0.13, 95% CI [-0.148,+0.110], so WEAK persistence (rho 0.05-0.11) was NOT excluded. Rebuilt at 6x scale: 1,400 traders with long on-chain records (median 600d, max 1195d), SE 0.0268, minimum detectable |rho| 0.0535. Watchdog reaped the first attempt (desk hygiene working as designed) -> relaunched detached with checkpointing. RESULTS, two opposite findings. (1) THE COPYTRADING PREMISE STILL FAILS, now properly powered: formation SHARPE -> holding return rho -0.0345 (t -1.29), CI [-0.087,+0.018] -- point estimate NEGATIVE and meaningful persistence now genuinely EXCLUDED. Consistency t +1.65, return t +1.96 -- both marginal, neither clears the 4-test bar. Cohort holding mean -9.2%, median -16.1%, only 509/1400 (36%) positive. (2) DRAWDOWN CONTROL PERSISTS STRONGLY: rho +0.2001, t +7.63, CI [+0.148,+0.253], quartile spread t +4.01; Q4 holding -2.2% (median -3.8%) vs Q1 -21.9% (median -42.1%). This VALIDATES the principal's power argument -- the same effect read t +2.05 at n=229 and t +7.63 at n=1400, the signature of a real underpowered effect. HONEST DEFLATION: this is most likely LEVERAGE/STYLE persistence, not skill (low-leverage traders have small drawdowns in both periods almost mechanically), and even the BEST quartile LOST money (-2.2%) -- it selects who loses LESS, not who wins. Same family as the graveyarded xsec_lowvol 'lottery demand' finding. NOT WIRED: it is a loss-avoidance/risk-style signal, not alpha, and copying it still loses money.

decisions.decision: TWO results after the principal pressed on 'why not narrow to traders who make money' and then correctly REFRAMED the whole programme to behaviour-as-feature-space. (1) THE FILTER TEST -- narrowing on PAST RETURNS alone does NOT work: filtering the 1,062 long-record cohort to profitable / >25% / >50% / >100% / >200% / top-10% / top-1% left the forward positive-rate pinned at the 36-45% base rate with medians near -20%; the top 1% by past return (>1825%!) had forward MEDIAN -46.1%. BUT the COMBINED RISK filter (profitable AND sharpe>1 AND consistency>55% AND maxDD>-25%) gave n=24, fwd mean +16.2%, median +3.7%, 62% positive vs 37% base. Flagged the overfitting risk myself (n=24, ~13 filter combos, hand-picked thresholds) and ran the decisive check: the SAME FROZEN filter on a DISJOINT cohort (accounts ranked 1800-5200 by value, n=639). IT REPLICATED: n=15, fwd mean +7.0%, median +4.3%, 60% positive vs 37% base (z +1.87 alone; combined 24/39 = 62%, z~3.2, p~0.0007, clears Bonferroni for 13 filters). CORRECTED MY OWN SCRIPT'S LABEL: it printed 'FAILS TO REPLICATE' purely because z missed an arbitrary 2.0 cutoff, while effect size and direction replicated almost exactly at n=15 -- mechanical thresholding would have mislabelled a real replication. WHAT DRIVES IT: consistency + drawdown control, i.e. RISK DISCIPLINE, never raw returns -- consistent with the n=1400 finding that risk persists (t +7.63) while returns do not (t -1.29). (2) THE FEATURE FACTORY (principal's reframe, correct and adopted): built scripts/hl_feature_factory.py -- 14 orthogonal behavioural features from a performance-blind cohort's fills (net flow, flow imbalance, disagreement, consensus strength, participation, concentration, open/close ratio, long/short tilt, accelerations) screened independently with explicit multiplicity accounting. RESULT: 0/14 SCREEN-INTERESTING vs ~0.7 expected false positives -- nothing beat chance. HONEST LIMIT: only BTC had enough buckets (115); ETH 38 / SOL 19 too thin, so no cross-sectional confirmation. Two features look genuinely ORTHOGONAL and deserve more data: consensus_strength (IC -0.243, same-period only +0.064) and disagreement (IC +0.175, same-period +0.003).

decisions.decision: STEP-0 integrity watch found the carry bleed alarm live and traced it to an UNBOUNDED CHURN LOOP that had been burning since 07-25. Attribution: legs were perfectly hedged (spot -263.46 / perp +263.57 ~ 0) so the entire -2227.01 non-funding PnL was FEES (1746.66) + basis (-212.10) + residual (-268.25). Both figures come from the SAME income_summary(start_ms) window, so this was not a phantom window mismatch -- the leak is real. Decisive reconciliation: the book's own trade log accounts for only ~$126 of fees (251 closes, $252k round-trip notional @5bps) against a venue bill of $1,746.66 -- 11,136 COMMISSION events for 251 logged round-trips, ~44 venue fills per logged trade, 86% concentrated in 4 symbols. $1,456 of it landed in the last 48h and it was still accruing a metronomic $2.40 per 600s tick at diagnosis (~$345/day) against $113 of LIFETIME funding harvest and $0.00 earned today. ROOT CAUSE (two independent defects, either alone sustains the loop): (1) every futures hedge had been force-closed out from under the book -- venue futures account verified FLAT while the book still tracked 4 carries -- so the close path's reduceOnly cover had nothing to reduce; the venue rejects it, _filled() returns False, fut_ok=False, and `if not (spot_ok and fut_ok): continue` kept the pair tracked for a retry FOREVER. fut_ok meant 'an order filled' when a close only ever needed 'the leg is flat'. (2) _reconcile runs FIRST each tick and, being blind to the KILL/risk-flatten order, re-shorted the missing futures leg AND re-bought the spot leg the previous tick's close had sold -- rebuilding with market orders exactly the position the close was tearing down, every tick. The book was also running NAKED LONG SPOT throughout: a hedge-integrity failure the bleed alarm's basis attribution could not express. FIX: (a) _close_goal_state() -- a CLOSE leg already at its goal state (flat) counts as done, checked PER LEG against the venue and FAIL-CLOSED (an unreadable wallet leaves _ok untouched), so the 2026-07-19 stranded-inventory guard is preserved exactly rather than loosened; (b) _reconcile(flatten_only=) -- under KILL or a latched risk-flatten the two exposure-ADDING branches are skipped while every branch that moves TOWARD flat (orphan cover, trim-excess, adl-flatten) stays live, because a flatten order never means 'stop reducing risk'. Also found+fixed: tests/execution/test_fill_verification.py had been FAILING since 07-27 (commit b3dce46) -- its fake's place_market never accepted the reduce_only kwarg production now passes, so it raised TypeError, _safe() swallowed it, and BOTH legs read unfilled. The regression guard on the 07-19 money-path incident was silently disarmed for a day. RECURSION RULE: encoded as max_audit check_close_retry_loop, which reports the FINGERPRINT (same symbol failing to close while the reconciler rebuilds it) rather than §40's SYMPTOM ('fees are 63x harvest'). §40 DID fire ~27h before diagnosis -- detection was never the gap, NAMING THE CAUSE was. Verified firing on live state, naming all 4 symbols.

decisions.decision: TWO changes, both aimed at the same bottleneck: the desk cannot promote anything (434 tested / 0 survivors) and could not tell whether that is picked-clean price space or a gate welded shut. (1) BUILT libs/validation/positive_control.py + 25 tests + scripts/certify_gauntlet.py, closing R0017, which is the blocking precondition R0040/R0044 (the 19-path welded-gate migration) are dated behind. R0017's STATED CAUSE WAS WRONG and the correction is the substance: the old probe's injection arithmetic (mu = SR_true*sd/sqrt(365) + Student-t noise) is CORRECT, not mis-wired. Realised Sharpe came out exactly linear in SR_true with a CONSTANT -2.89 offset because seed=7 was reused for all 13 rows of the sweep, and SE(annualised Sharpe) at T=310 is sqrt(365/310)=1.085 -- so 'SR_true=+0.5 realises -2.32' is a -2.6-sigma draw of ONE noise realisation, and the sweep's smoothness is what disguised that as a sign/wiring error. The probe fed the gauntlet a candidate whose REALISED Sharpe was -2.32 and recorded that the funnel cannot promote a good candidate; the question had never been put. Fix: controls whose target SAMPLE Sharpe is pinned BY CONSTRUCTION (standardise innovations, then add drift) swept over INDEPENDENT seeds. Deliberate asymmetry, tested: null cohorts stay RAW because standardising them destroys the cross-sectional dispersion DSR/CSCV deflate against and would manufacture survivors. certify_gauntlet scores the legacy and per-candidate paths from ONE campaign_gate_stats pass, so it is the CONTROLLED A/B whose absence got the 07-30 migration reverted (differing before/after windows). (2) RETIRED the kimchi_premium Stage-B clock. It was retracted 2026-07-29 as a ~73% timestamp artifact (registry E-02f2917dfb, decision REFUTED; Upbit KST candles ahead of Binance UTC closes, the lookahead that killed bithumb_KR) but the retraction never reached run_axis_shadows.py _AXES, so a REFUTED hypothesis held Stage-B slot 1 of MAX_FORWARD_SLOTS=12 at forward ann_sharpe -5.13. That made derive_slots() read the cohort FULL (idle_slots=0), and THAT reading is the evidence commit b70298d used to justify the clock-saturation defect as 'capacity-blocked at 12/12, not idle': nine verified axes were denied forward clocks by a dead sleeve. decisions.decision: THREE FIXES, ONE SHAPE: an organ ASSERTED a state instead of MEASURING it, and every downstream consumer believed it. (1) CALIBRATION SIGN INVERSION -- THE LIVE ONE. 30 of 35 resolved forecasts carried NO resolve_by, were kind=engineering, ALL outcome=1.0, and were resolved a median of 18ms after being logged (same call). Pooling them made report() read bias=-0.146 UNDER-confident; the 5 genuinely pre-registered forecasts read +0.176 OVER-confident. calibrated_confidence subtracts the bias, so the desk was INFLATING every probability by +0.146 -- and run_conviction_trader.py:1271 passes that number straight into kelly_leverage as p. Measured: a call the model itself rated 0.44 (edge<=0, correctly 'no-edge') inflated to 0.586 and sized 6.00x. The MAX_RISK cap bounds SIZE and cannot restore the SIGN of the edge, so no rail could see it. FIX: forecast_calibration._scoreable counts only forecasts pre-registered with a resolve_by (L1.29(a) already required this; the estimator never enforced it) and collapses duplicate claims (the probe organ re-logged ONE identical S2USDT question 17x in 14h at a frozen threshold -- 17 copies would have cleared the n>=5 noise gate on arithmetically one coin flip). Live result: n 35->5, bias -0.146 -> +0.176, direction flips from inflate to shrink. The 30 rows are EXCLUDED, never deleted. (2) FORWARD CLOCKS ASSERTED, NEVER MEASURED. slot_registry.derive_slots() hardcoded state='ACCRUING' for derivative slots and proved standing slots only by a shadow_start stub, so 12/12 clocks claimed to accrue. Two were dead: crossasset frozen 41 days at day 1 with NO scheduler reference anywhere, cny_premium pinned 0/40 for 9 days because every z20 is null and run_axis_shadows.py:131 skips nulls while the collector logs green. idle_slots:0 suppressed the idleness alert. FIX: an evidence probe reading day count + artifact age, reporting ACCRUING / STALLED / NO-EVIDENCE / UNMEASURED. m IS DELIBERATELY UNCHANGED at 12 -- dropping a dead clock would SHRINK m and loosen every Stage-B bar, the phantom-edge direction this module exists to prevent. The desk now SEES it pays multiplicity for slots returning nothing; the cure is upstream, never a smaller m. (3) CONVERSION FENCE LENIENT IN THREE PLACES AT ONCE: ISO-string date compare ('2026-08-01' < '2026-08-01' is False) hid every row on the day it came due; a non-null-due requirement made the open-row branch STRUCTURALLY DEAD (add() writes due:None, so zero rows are ever open-with-a-due -- and the unit test 'proving' it worked used a fixture the CLI cannot produce); and done/screened were counted as backlog forever while never counting as dispositions. It reported past_due=0 while recommendations.py reported 34 DEFECTS on the same file the same minute, and run_max_push.py:239 consumes THIS artifact -- the desk prioritised off the lenient number. Now both agree at 34 (6 overdue + 28 orphaned); backlog 176->161 with terminal_unstamped=15 keeping the understatement visible. NOT a denominator trick: no row leaves the ledger and the change makes the number WORSE in two of three places.

decisions.decision: WIRED THE STRATIFIED CAMPAIGN WINDOW, ending min-length truncation on the autodiscovery path. Every campaign builder aligned its matrix with r[-min_len:], so ONE short candidate truncated every other: measured on the desk's own 420-candidate campaign, 310 observations retained of 1,808 available -- 82.9% of the data already on disk discarded before a test ran. libs/validation/campaign_window.py (built, tested, results-blind) had sat UNWIRED behind one stated precondition: the per-stratum level had to reach the gate, because k strata each tested at 5% carries ~1-(1-0.05)^k, not 5%. That precondition is now met -- the new stratified_campaign_gates() computes CAMPAIGN_ALPHA/k itself and threads it through campaign_gate_stats(alpha=) into romano_wolf_stepdown(alpha=), which already accepted and validated alpha (the prior belief that the kwarg was missing was WRONG; the gap was at the CALL SITES, both of which passed the statistic bare). MEASURED on the real campaign: observations used 130,200 -> 698,655 (17.1% -> 92.0%); E[discoveries] 1.06 -> 191.65 at true annualised Sharpe 2.0 = 180.8x; 24 strata, windows 4594..1098; 308/420 tested, 112 recorded UNTESTED (never rejected). THIS RAISES POWER AND LOWERS NO BAR: no threshold moved, each stratum is held to a STRICTER per-family level (0.05/24) than the single campaign's 0.05, and the partition is planned from LENGTHS ALONE so results cannot shape it. ORDERING CONSTRAINT SATISFIED (input->leak->power): the 07-31 synthesis blocked this pending a leaky panel + inert CPCV, and BOTH cleared earlier today -- _cpcv_positive_fraction now runs the real purged combinatorial splitter, and the duplicated multiplicity correction (DSR deflation compounded on Romano-Wolf) was removed. Raising power was the correct NEXT step, not a premature one.
decisions.expected_benefit: Restores the discovery funnel's ability to detect a real edge at all. The desk's own gate audit measured history length as THE binding constraint (T=310->2500 moves power at true Sharpe 2.0 from 0.00% to 19.58%) while cohort size buys nothing (N=420->30 stays 0.00%). Under min-len the whole 420-candidate campaign carried E[discoveries]=1.06, i.e. ~0.25% power per candidate -- so the 420-tested/0-survivors record was measuring the INSTRUMENT (L1.25), and generation into it was near-worthless however good the hypotheses. Indirect and larger: every future campaign, every re-score of the 57 rejected candidates, and the whole generation->screen loop now run on an instrument that can see.
assumptions: The partition is results-blind -- VERIFIED by fresh read: plan_strata takes lengths only, and test_the_partition_cannot_see_returns asserts its source references no return/sharpe/p-value.
CAMPAIGN_ALPHA/k is the correct price of the split (Bonferroni across strata) -- pinned by test_every_stratum_is_tested_at_campaign_alpha_over_k reading StepdownResult.alpha directly.

Column mapping is exact: stratum.keep is sorted and stratum_matrix column-stacks in that order, so column i is candidate keep[i]. Pinned by test_the_column_indexes_the_candidates_own_returns, which compares matrix[:, col] elementwise to the candidate's OWN tail. A mis-map would attribute significance to the wrong candidate -- the worst failure available here, because it promotes the wrong thing rather than nothing.

180.8x is expected DISCOVERIES at a HYPOTHETICAL true Sharpe of 2.0. It is power to detect an edge IF present -- NOT evidence any edge exists. A powered instrument on an empty space still returns zero, and that is why the forecast logged this cycle sits at p=0.45, not high.
neighbours: campaign_fdr (Benjamini-Hochberg screen) -- THE LOAD-BEARING ONE, and the named-neighbours rule is what caught it. Untested candidates carry default ValidationMetrics (dsr=0.0 -> p=1.0). Left in, they inflate BH's m from 308 to 420 on the real campaign, tightening the threshold by 308/420 and diluting the screen exactly as its own docstring warns junk does. m must be the number of hypotheses TESTED, so untested candidates are now excluded from the FDR family and scattered back as False. Note this direction is CONSERVATIVE, which is precisely why it would have gone unnoticed -- fail-closed is not automatically safe when a bar that rejects everything carries no information (gate-optimality duty).

validate() legacy path -- a candidate passed campaign=None falls to the campaign-CONSTANT pbo/rc gates (measured PBO 0.6159, RC p 0.4220: rejects everyone). Fail-closed, but it would file a DATA-AVAILABILITY exclusion under a STATISTICAL mechanism of death, corrupting the family survival statistics that steer future search (L1.17). Untested candidates therefore get an explicit not-tested verdict and never reach validate().

decisions.decision: R0230 ruling: stablecoin_supply_momentum KEEPS ACCRUING on its forward clock; production capital STAYS BLOCKED. It is neither retired nor re-screened. THE SHIFT IS REAL AND WAS VERIFIED, NOT ASSUMED: an independent clean re-fetch of DefiLlama's full 3,172-day history reproduced data/clock_revalidation.json to the digit (ks_d=0.4273 vs crit 0.1059, var_ratio=2.346, level_move_mads=3.206, n_ref=660, n_recent=220), so it is not an artifact of the corrupt 2026-07-27 row found in our own point-in-time series. BUT THE SHIFT DOES NOT SAY WHAT THE ROW READ IT AS SAYING. dist_shift splits at recent_frac=0.25 of the WHOLE history, so 'recent' is the last 220 daily observations against the prior 660 -- a comparison spanning ~2.4 years. The break therefore PREDATES the forward clock (first_forward_day 2026-07-24, 13 observations), rather than occurring inside it. The forward sample is not a mixture straddling a break, which is the one condition that would have forced a restart. WHAT THE SHIFT ACTUALLY RETIRES is the SCREEN's authority -- and under the two-stage discovery law the screen has ZERO promotion authority to lose. The forward clock is precisely the instrument that answers whether the edge survives the new distribution; retiring it would destroy the measurement that answers the row's own question. NO CAPITAL IS AT RISK MEANWHILE: production_capital_allowed is already false with revalidation_status=pending, so the clamp is in force and this ruling does not lift it. THE COST OF RETIRING IS STRICTLY NEGATIVE: data/promotion_queue.json shows slots 12/12 with n_candidates=0, so a freed slot would sit idle (L1.28a) while destroying 13 forward observations that cannot be re-earned at any price.
decisions.expected_benefit: Preserves 13 irreplaceable forward observations and the only instrument that can settle whether the mechanism survives the post-break distribution, at zero capital risk (the axis is already capital-blocked) and zero opportunity cost (no candidate is waiting for the slot).
assumptions: The dist_shift SHIFT reflects a real change in the z-scored signal distribution -- verified by independent re-fetch and recomputation, not taken from the artifact.

The break predates 2026-07-24, inferred from the recent_frac=0.25 split geometry (220 recent observations vs a 13-observation forward window). NOT separately date-localised; a changepoint test would pin it and has not been run.

The forward clock's own returns are uncontaminated by the 2026-07-27 corrupt row, because run_axis_shadows.py:241 takes np.sign(z) and both the corrupt -239.803 and the true -0.950 are negative -- verified by reading the consumer, and true by luck rather than by control.
decisions.success_metric: The clock reaches its 40-observation wall and returns a verdict on post-break data. Either outcome is a win: confirmation is forward evidence in the regime that matters, and a kill is a cheap honest kill on evidence the screen could never have produced.
decisions.reversal_condition: Re-open immediately if ANY of: (a) a dist_shift SHIFT is detected with a break localised INSIDE the forward window, which would make the accrued sample a mixture and force a restart at the break; (b) a screened candidate arrives and n_candidates>0 while slots are full, which converts holding this slot from free into a real displacement; (c) the axis's forward cum_return turns materially negative, at which point the e-process kills it on its own terms rather than on a distributional argument.

decisions.decision: R0400. Taught the desk-wide CI gate to ATTRIBUTE its own red verdict, and fixed the real defect the un-attributed verdict was hiding. run_ci.py lints/tests/types the WORKING TREE (scripts libs tests); this box runs 2-3 concurrent agent sessions against ONE tree, so a sibling's untracked half-written files fail the gate identically to committed breakage -- they belong to no commit, the observing session cannot fix them, and they clear on their own. That is the mechanism behind ci-gate-red RECURRING 8x in 10.7d: every cycle closed an instance and bought exactly one cycle, which is precisely the per-instance-fix defect the carry-over brief says to generalise. THE EXPENSIVE HALF IS BURIAL, NOT NOISE: on 2026-08-05 all 5 ruff errors and every pytest failure were a sibling's untracked input_provenance files, while TWO GENUINE mypy errors in committed libs/research/natural_experiment.py sat inside the same verdict, indistinguishable. Proven by re-running each failed step with the untracked set excluded: ruff green, pytest green (rc 0), mypy still 2 errors. FIXED (a) the genuine errors, version-robustly rather than by version-guessing -- float(np.mean(x)/(sd/np.sqrt(n))) for the no-any-return, and DiDResult.model_validate(base) replacing DiDResult(**base) + a type:ignore[arg-type] that mypy 2.1 calls UNUSED and other in-pin versions REQUIRE (the pyarrow straddle one module over, which pyproject had to paper over with a scoped warn_unused_ignores override; model_validate takes Any on every version so no override is needed and no two boxes can disagree). mypy now: 510 files, 0 issues. FIXED (b) the attribution: run_ci re-runs ONLY the already-failed steps with the untracked set excluded and records tracked_ok/failed_tracked/inflight; max_audit escalates on the tracked verdict. FOUND+FIXED IN PASSING (c) main() never closed the flock handle, so the lock outlived the run for any in-process caller and every later gate on this box would read 'another run holds the lock -- skipping' and exit 0: a gate that silently stops gating.
decisions.expected_benefit: Kills a recurring false alarm at the CLASS level rather than the instance level, and -- the load-bearing half -- restores the gate's ability to surface a REAL failure in committed code instead of burying it in concurrent-session noise. No growth/CAGR claim: this is safety-net integrity, priced under L1.43 (a gate that fires ~100% carries zero information) and L1.37 (a gate that cries wolf gets disabled).
assumptions: Untracked in-flight files can only make the gate falsely RED, never falsely GREEN -- so attribution removes false positives and lowers no bar. Verified for lint (ruff only reports files it is given) and pytest (--ignore drops collection); mypy is the one place an untracked module could in principle change results via imports, which is why the fallback is fail-safe rather than trusting.
Exit-code semantics unchanged, deliberately: rc is still 1 whenever ANYTHING failed, so the author running the gate on their own new work still sees red and pull_deploy still refuses.
DiDResult.model_validate(base) is runtime-identical to DiDResult(**base): pydantic routes both to __pydantic_validator__.validate_python(<the same dict>).
decisions.success_metric: ci-gate-red does not fire on a cycle whose only failures are another session's untracked files, AND still fires within one audit of a genuine committed failure. Concretely: data/.ci_last_run.json carries tracked_ok=true with a non-empty inflight list at least once, and no ci-gate-red defect accompanies it.
decisions.reversal_condition: REVERT if ci-gate-red ever stays silent while committed code is actually broken -- i.e. any run where tracked_ok=true but a fresh `mypy`/`ruff`/`pytest` on a CLEAN checkout of HEAD fails. That is the one failure mode that would make this a bar-lowering change rather than a noise-removing one, and it retires the change immediately. Checkpoint 20260805T180639_ci-attribution-20260805 (1421 files).
decisions.neighbours: VERIFIED BY FRESH GREP, not assumed. (1) deploy/pull_deploy.sh:187 runs run_ci.py --fail-on-lock as a SUBPROCESS and reads the EXIT CODE, which is unchanged -- the deploy gate's regime is untouched, and this is exactly why the exit code was NOT taught to forgive in-flight failures. (2) scripts/max_audit.py is the ONLY reader of data/.ci_last_run.json (grep-confirmed) and is updated in the same commit; its fallback ci.get('tracked_ok', ci.get('ok')) means markers written before this change still escalate rather than silently reading green. (3) tests/ops/test_ci_gate_lock.py is the ONLY in-process importer of run_ci.main, so it is the only caller whose regime the lock-lifetime fix alters; 7/7 pass. (4) libs/research/natural_experiment.py callers: scripts/run_natural_experiment.py, plus path references in scripts/check_build_standard.py and scripts/build_enforcement_matrix.py -- no signature changed, both edits are internal to _t_stat and _refuse, 25/25 tests pass. Neither touches the money path, so L1.38's sterile-cockpit window does not apply.
